idea-plugin.name: keel
idea-plugin.description:
keel inside the IDE: answer the questions your keel flows wait at, review pull request threads in the editor with keel's "Is the reviewer right?" check, start a flow from a selection, and chat with KeelBot (Ask / Fix / Edit).

  • Review: pull requests, threads inside the file's diff, Reply / Resolve / Address it, pending comments, Submit review.
  • Flows: the flow list, a flow's steps and criteria, and its waiting question with named choices.
  • Start a flow: Tools menu, the tool window, or Alt+Enter on a selection.
  • KeelBot: a chat with file links; its changed lines show in the editor with Keep / Undo / Diff.

Connect in Settings › Tools › keel: use keel2 on this computer, or pair with a code like the phone app.
